title:
BTO ceiling now
*$16,000*

lines.say: You earn 15,000 dollars a month as a couple. Last year, that was too much for a BTO. Not any more.
From 24 August 2026, the BTO income ceiling for families went from 14,000 to 16,000 dollars.
For singles, it went up to 8,000 dollars.
HDB moved the October BTO launch to November, so more buyers can apply under the new limits.
About 7,900 flats are expected across towns like Bedok, Tengah, Toa Payoh and Yishun.
Earning close to the line? Your income is assessed when you apply, so the timing of a raise or bonus matters.
Not sure if you qualify? Comment CHECK.

caption:
Earning $15,000 a month as a couple? You may now qualify for a BTO. 🏠

From 24 August 2026, the BTO income ceiling for families went from $14,000 to $16,000. For singles, it's now $8,000.

HDB moved the October BTO launch to November so more buyers can apply under the new limits. About 7,900 flats are expected across towns like Bedok, Tengah, Toa Payoh and Yishun.

Earning close to the line? Your income is assessed when you apply, so timing matters.

Not sure if you qualify? Comment CHECK 👇

Average gross monthly household income. Full eligibility rules on HDB.
